title: A screen reader reads the empty chart outline as No data to chart
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).
  4. You have a screen reader. On a Mac use VoiceOver, which is built in: press Command + F5 to turn it on or off. On Windows use NVDA (free from nvaccess.org): install it, start it with Ctrl + Alt + N, and stop it with Insert + Q.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. Create nothing in it.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop selected.
  2. Turn the screen reader on.
  3. Move through the Billing Efficiency tile one item at a time: on a Mac press Control + Option + Right Arrow, on Windows with NVDA press the Down Arrow.
  4. Listen to what is read when you reach the empty-chart outline.
  5. Do the same on the Revenue tile.
  6. Turn the screen reader off.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When you reach the outline, the screen reader says "No data to chart" (on both tiles).
  • It does not read the outline as an unlabelled image, a graphic or nothing at all.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 4. The design board shows the outline only as a picture; the spoken text comes from the PRD alone.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R17: “A screen reader reads the placeholder as "No data to chart".”
